name: Breakfast Casserole
notes: Originated at the 2022 Houghton reunion for Lander’s Blessing Brunch. Jimmy Dean was tasty.

items: 3.5 pounds potato, diced to ½ cubes
1 large red or yellow bell pepper
1 cup whipping cream (or ½ cup sour cream and ½ cup milk)

steps.title: Toss the potatoes
steps.body: Toss together **3.5 pounds potato**, diced to ½ cubes, **2 Tbsp oil** and **1 tsp garlic salt**.

steps.title: Bake the potatoes
steps.body: Bake on a baking sheet at 425°F for about 30 minutes or until tender, turning occasionally.

steps.title: Cook the sausage
steps.body: Meanwhile, sauté, crumble and drain **1.5 breakfast sausage**.

steps.title: Add the onion and pepper
steps.body: Add **1 red onion**, diced, and **1 large red or yellow bell pepper** and sauté until tender.

steps.title: Layer the casserole
steps.body: Spread the potatoes and sausage mixture on the bottom of a greased 9×12 casserole dish, then sprinkle with **2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese**.

steps.title: Make the egg mixture
steps.body: Combine and whisk together **18 eggs**, **1 tsp salt**, **½ tsp lemon pepper**, **½ tsp red pepper flakes**, **1 tsp parsley** and **1 cup whipping cream** (or **½ cup sour cream** and **½ cup milk**).

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour over mixture in pan and bake at 350°F for 45–60 minutes, until set.
